<thought>To determine the number of methyl groups, I will obtain the ¹H NMR spectrum of the sample. Methyl protons appear as signals around 0.8‑1.2 ppm (often singlets, doublets, etc.) and each methyl contributes integration of 3 H. By analyzing the spectrum I can count how many such methyl signals are present.</thought>
